column1: # BORU Language Specification: Module / ModuleExport (Ideal types)
# `import` binds each `export "Name" {…}` to a ModuleExport instance
# the raw export, so calling/using exports is unchanged — and carries two
# A Module (Ideal/Module) is the shared descriptor with normal fields
# id, kind, file, folder, exports. The import reference stays lowercase
# §1  the bound namespace is a ModuleExport, transparent for use

column3: transparent: exports are used as before

column1: # §2  $module → the Module descriptor (Ideal/Module) and its fields
# §4  inline modules — `import module […]` binds all exports; kind="inline"

column3: exports lists every export of the module
a second export is independently accessible

column1: import module [export "A" {x:1} export "B" {y:2}]  A.$module is B.$module
column3: all exports of a module share one Module instance

column1: # §5  rename import — $name keeps the original export name

column3: $name is the declared export name, not the alias

column1: # §6  negative — a missing export via getr (!.) errors

column3: unknown export raises not_found (the documented strict-lookup code)

column1: # §7  minted-type identity is per-mint, across module boundaries.
# Types minted in sibling registries (two inline module bodies, or a
# module body and the importing top level) are DISTINCT lattice nodes —
# the dynamic-ID counter is process-global, so same-ordinal mints in
# forked registries can never collide (they did once: a refine of
# Integer in one module was teq-identical to a refine of String in
import module [def Foo (refine Integer) export "M1" {Foo: Foo}] import module [def Foo (refine Integer) export "M2" {Foo: Foo}] M1.Foo teq M2.Foo
column3: same-shaped newtypes from two modules are distinct nominal identities

column1: import module [def Foo (refine Integer) export "M1" {Foo: Foo}] import module [def Bar (refine String) export "M2" {Bar: Bar}] M1.Foo teq M2.Bar
column3: different-shaped mints from two modules are distinct (the original collision)

column1: import module [def Foo (refine Integer) export "M1" {Foo: Foo}] def A (refine String) A teq M1.Foo
column3: the first top-level mint after an import is distinct from the module's mint

column1: import module [def Foo (refine Integer) export "M1" {Foo: Foo}] M1.Foo teq M1.Foo
column3: a module's exported type is teq-identical to itself

column1: import module [def Foo (refine Integer) export "M1" {Foo: Foo}] import module [def Foo (refine Integer) export "M2" {Foo: Foo}] def F1 M1.Foo def F2 M2.Foo def x:F1 5 x is F2
column3: a value of one module's newtype is NOT a member of another module's same-shaped newtype

column1: import module [def Foo (refine Integer) export "M1" {Foo: Foo}] def F1 M1.Foo def x:F1 5 x is F1
column3: membership in the owning module's type is unaffected
